notes: NPCs stand where a level places them. A merchant opens a shop when the hero presses the interact key beside them; anyone else just talks.

goods are what can be bought with gold. kind 'upgrade' is permanent and kept by that hero between levels: each level bought adds 'perLevel' to a stat, up to 'maxLevel'. Its price starts at 'price' and is multiplied by 'priceGrowth' for each level already owned.
Upgrade stats: damage, attackSpeed, moveSpeed, mpRegen, hpRegen and toughness add a fraction (0.1 is +10%); maxHp and maxMp add points.
kind 'item' is used at once and can be bought again: 'gives' has the same meaning as for objects (hp, mp, hpFraction, mpFraction, keys, boost).
stock lists the goods a merchant sells. lines are what the NPC says: greet (hero comes near), bought, poor (not enough gold), talk (interact, for those who do not trade).
box is the area the hero must stand in to interact, relative to the NPC's pivot. All lines and prices are first drafts.

blessing.name: Blessing
blessing.description: Restores all HP and MP now

iron_key.name: Iron Key
iron_key.description: Opens one locked chest or gate

greet: Coin first, friend. Then we talk.
poor: Come back when your purse is heavier.

greet: Goods from every road I've walked.
You look like someone who travels light. Too light.
bought: It served me well. It'll serve you better.
poor: I carry all this on my back. I can't carry your debts too.

greet: Sit a moment, child. The dead can wait.
My charms have kept this village longer than its walls.
bought: May it hold when you cannot.
poor: The herbs cost me the walk, if nothing else.

greet: The sun still rises. Take heart.
You carry a heavy road. Let me lighten it.
poor: The temple roof leaks, friend. Even blessings need a little coin.

talk: They say a king still sits his throne, below the crypt.
My grandfather swore the big wolf was only a story.
If you find a gate you can't open, look for a lever. Or a key.
The old woman's charms work. Don't ask me how I know.
